title: chrysanthemum leucanthemum var. alpicola
intro: Chrysanthemum leucanthemum var. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Daisy are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be due to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Daisy have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
